subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers review/adopt the open fork PR that closes this issue, or close it and use a replacement path?
rationale: A concrete fix candidate already exists but is unmerged and not maintainer-editable, so starting a new automated repair without a maintainer choice would risk duplicating active contributor work.

options.title: Review or replace linked fix
options.body: Use `https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1175` as the source of the narrow patch; if the branch cannot be updated, open a credited replacement before closing it.

options.title: Ask contributor for editable follow-up
options.body: Request maintainer edits or an updated branch on the linked PR, then review the edge-case behavior there.

options.title: Close linked PR and re-triage
options.body: If the linked PR is not acceptable as source material, close it with rationale and then re-enable a new repair lane for this issue.

recommendation.title: Review or replace linked fix
recommendation.body: Use `https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1175` as the source of the narrow patch; if the branch cannot be updated, open a credited replacement before closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the default cron stagger controls and is the strongest history-backed owner for choosing the landing path.
